title: What sold in October
summary: Three houses closed in October, including a Reach cottage over list. A short, public look at the month.
body:
October was quieter than September, which had two Common foursquares over list, but it was not a stall. 31 Fenwater Walk closed over its asking price, and two other houses that had been under contract since September finished their closings.

Inventory is still tight in the Reach and on Ferry Green. West Common has more to look at this month, including 41 West Common and the coming listing on Lintel Street.

title: Saturday market table
summary: We staff a table on the west side of the courthouse lawn, 8 am to noon, on market Saturdays.
body: If you would rather not come into the office, the market table is the easiest way to pick up a sheet or ask about a house. We do not take offers or signatures at the table; that still happens at the office or by phone.

title: How to make an offer
summary: Offers go through the office, in writing, by email or on paper. There is no offer form on this site.
body: We write offers at the office. Call (555) 014-1860, or email the listing agent named on the sheet. We do not collect offers, names or payments through this website, on purpose.

title: Shortlist for this week
summary: A private note for signed-in buyer clients: three houses worth seeing before the weekend, and one to wait on.
body:
If you have already told us you want a porch and a walkable street, start with 19 Ferry Green on Saturday and 14 Millrace Row after that. 2 Brick Kiln Row is the price opening, but only if you are ready for a small kitchen.

8 Lintel Street is not public until Friday. If you want a first look, call me and I will tell you whether Wednesday's broker tour still has a window.

Skip 3 Pinion Court unless you specifically want a ranch and a view; it has been on the market long enough that we can be patient.

title: Pre-approval before Saturday
summary: If you plan to write on a house after this weekend's opens, have a pre-approval letter in the file first.
body: Sellers in this town still move quickly on clean offers. A pre-approval letter, or a proof of funds if you are paying cash, should be in our file before Saturday if you think you might write. We can tell you who in town is used to these older houses.

title: Expiring this month
summary: Desk note: two listings need a conversation with the seller before Thanksgiving, and one coming house has a broker tour on Wednesday.
body:
3 Pinion Court has been on since late October in spirit (listed 22 Oct) and is the one I want everyone talking about honestly with Lila before we discuss a price change.

8 Lintel Street's broker tour is Wednesday 10–12. Please do not bring buyers unannounced; take the tour, then call me.

55 West Common is on track to close the first week of December. If you hear any rumor that it is shaky, I want that first.

title: Private remarks reminder
summary: Private remarks on a listing are for signed-in agents only. They are not to be read aloud in a living room or pasted into a public sheet.
body: The site already withholds private remarks from anyone who is not signed in as an agent. Still, do not quote them on a tour. If a buyer is working with us, put what they need into a showing note instead.

title: Client: Mae Hollister
summary: Mae is signed in as the demo buyer client. She is looking at Ferry Green and the Reach, three bedrooms if possible, under $400,000 if we can do it.
body: Mae has already walked 19 Ferry Green with me and wants a second look on Saturday. 14 Millrace Row is also in range. 2 Brick Kiln Row is cheaper but probably too small. She is pre-approved and can close in January.
